div.head: VI Atr Lat 1.3
div.ab: Ibi ergo episcopi, ut erga creditę sibi salutem plebis — paganorum incursionibus uel inruptionibus ceterisque calamitatum erumnis pluriformium obprimentibus, a religionis tramite recto anfractibus errabundis exorbitantis — peruigiles existerent, eisque uitę pabula uel alimenta, quibus ad fidei cultum catholicę recrearentur, sollicite instanterque ministrarent, monitibus cogebantur intentis. Memores enim fore prophete monebantur dicentis: ‘Pascite, qui in uobis est, gregem Dei’.
div.note: Latin paraphrase of VI Atr (early 11th c.; K = Cotton Claudius A III f. 30), text in column K (Liebermann’s text; until October 2026 in column T). This passage has no Old English equivalent; Liebermann gives no German translation.; T: corrected against Gesetze I, October 2026 (was “(Liebermann’s Latin Paraphrase)”, now “∅ (moved to K)”)
